name: Progressive Blur
description: Text melts into blur at the page edges as it scrolls, like iOS. Stacked layers, any edge, exponential curve, viewport-pinned mode and optional tint.

props.name: maxBlur
props.description: Blur radius at the edge, in pixels.

props.name: tint
props.description: Fade to the background color on top of the blur.

props.name: fixed
props.description: Pin to the viewport edge for a page-wide effect.

props.name: className
props.description: Size the blur area, e.g. h-32 or w-24.
